mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate signals tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to reduced liquidity and higher borrowing costs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances following a 0.25% increase in FEDFUNDS over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates weakening labor market conditions, which typically precedes economic slowdowns and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances following a 0.5pp increase in UNRATE over 2 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, which is typically associated with positive economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances following a sustained increase in RSAFS.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a contraction in supply, which can lead to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances following a 1% decline in INDPRO over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) is rising, it indicates a potential overheating economy, which can lead to future monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < 1% and CPIAUCSL rises > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 1% and CPIAUCSL rises > 0.5% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising unemployment (UNRATE) and falling nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a weakening labor market, which typically precedes broader economic weakness and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.3pp and PAYEMS declines > 100k in 2 months
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances following a 0.3pp rise in UNRATE and a 100k decline in PAYEMS over 2 months.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in housing starts (HOUST) coupled with a rise in consumer prices (CPIAUCSL) indicates strong demand and inflationary pressures, which can lead to monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST rises > 10% and CPIAUCSL rises > 1% in 6 months
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances following a 10% rise in HOUST and a 1% rise in CPIAUCSL over 6 months.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) coupled with a rise in unemployment (UNRATE) signals a contraction in both supply and labor, which can lead to a broad economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO declines > 1% and UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 3 months
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances following a 1% decline in INDPRO and a 0.3pp rise in UNRATE over 3 months.
